metadata.title: Mathematics, Music & Physics Workflow Template Library (Node/Edge DAG Model)
metadata.description: 8 example workflow DAGs (3 mathematics, 3 music, 2 physics) built from agent nodes (referencing agent_template_id in math_music_physics_agent_templates.json) and primitive nodes (input, decision, condition, evaluate, approval, join, loop). Every primitive type is exercised multiple times across the set. See node_type_schema below for the config contract each node type follows, including how bounded iteration is expressed without introducing a literal cycle in the top-level 'edges' array (which remains a true DAG).

agent.description: Invokes an agent template (from the companion agent-templates file) on the current workflow state.

config_fields.agent_template_id: id referencing a record in the agent-template library
config_fields.input_keys: list of workflow-state keys passed to the agent as input
config_fields.output_key: workflow-state key the agent's result is written to
config_fields.instruction_override: optional — narrows/customizes the agent's standing prompt for this specific node

input.description: Entry point of a workflow (or sub-flow). Captures and validates the initial payload before any processing begins.

config_fields.expected_fields: list of required field names in the incoming payload

input.graph_rule: has no incoming edges within its workflow

decision.description: Multi-way branch (3+ possible outcomes) driven by a categorical value, typically an upstream agent's classification output.

config_fields.basis: the workflow-state field the branch decision reads (e.g. 'formulated_model.problem_class')
config_fields.default_to: node id to route to if no branch value matches

decision.graph_rule: emits one outgoing edge per branch, each edge's 'on' field equal to that branch's 'when' value

condition.description: Simple boolean gate evaluated against workflow state.

config_fields.expression: human-readable boolean expression over workflow-state fields
config_fields.true_to: node id to route to when the expression evaluates true
config_fields.false_to: node id to route to when the expression evaluates false

condition.graph_rule: emits exactly two outgoing edges, labeled on='true' and on='false'

evaluate.description: Scores or grades an artifact against a rubric/metric and writes a quantitative or structured verdict to workflow state. Does not itself branch — a downstream 'condition' node reads its output to decide what happens next.

config_fields.output_key: workflow-state key the score/verdict is written to

approval.description: Human-in-the-loop gate. Execution pauses until a designated approver responds or the SLA elapses.

config_fields.approver_role: the human role expected to respond (not a specific person)
config_fields.on_approve: node id to route to on approval
config_fields.on_reject: node id to route to on rejection (commonly a loop node, to route feedback back into revision)
config_fields.on_timeout: behavior if no response arrives, e.g. 'escalate' | 'auto_reject' | 'escalate_reminder'

join.description: Merge/reconvergence point for multiple upstream branches — either true concurrent parallel branches, or mutually-exclusive branches from an upstream decision/condition node reconverging into one downstream path.

config_fields.inputs: list of upstream node ids this join waits on
config_fields.strategy: 'wait_all' (true parallel fan-in — every input must complete) or 'wait_any' (reconvergence of mutually-exclusive branches — proceed as soon as one input completes)

loop.description: Bounded iteration over a sub-sequence of already-defined nodes ('the body'), re-executed until an exit condition is met or max_iterations is reached. IMPORTANT: to keep the top-level 'edges' list a true DAG (acyclic), a loop node does NOT introduce a literal back-edge in the edges array. Instead, iteration is expressed purely as node configuration: 'body' lists the node ids (in execution order) that get re-run each pass, and 'loop_back_to' names the body node where the next pass resumes. Every real outgoing edge a loop node has in the edges array is labeled on='loop_exit' (there can be more than one if the loop's exit fans out into parallel next-steps), pointing to whatever comes after the loop finishes, whether it exited by meeting exit_condition or by hitting max_iterations.

config_fields.body: ordered list of node ids that make up the loop's repeated sub-sequence
config_fields.loop_back_to: node id (must be in body) where a new iteration resumes
config_fields.exit_condition: human-readable condition checked after each pass through body
config_fields.max_iterations: hard cap on passes, guaranteeing termination even if exit_condition is never met

loop.graph_rule: 1+ outgoing edges in the edges array, every one labeled on='loop_exit' (more than one only when the loop's exit fans out to parallel next-steps); body-node ids must all exist in this workflow's nodes list

workflows.name: Optimization Problem Solving Pipeline
workflows.description:
Takes a natural-language decision problem through formal modeling, routes it to
    the right solution method by problem class, evaluates solution quality, iterates on
    the model if the solution is infeasible or suboptimal, and gates final release
    behind analyst sign-off.
workflows.trigger: user submits a decision problem in natural language (objective + constraints)

workflows.name: Trigonometric Identity Verification & Tutoring Loop
workflows.description:
Verifies a student-submitted trig identity claim, builds an explanation
    appropriate to whichever outcome (proved or disproved), and loops a tutoring
    explanation with comprehension checks until the student demonstrates mastery or a
    max-attempt cap is reached.
workflows.trigger: student submits a claimed trigonometric identity to check and learn from

nodes.label: Generate Tutoring Explanation for Student Level

workflows.name: Advanced Algebra Proof & Peer-Review Workflow
workflows.description:
Constructs a proof for a submitted theorem, runs an independent step-by-step
    verification, loops revision-and-reverification until every step is valid (or a cap
    is hit), then gates publication behind a human mathematician's sign-off.
workflows.trigger: user submits a theorem statement (with an optional draft proof sketch)

workflows.name: Audio-to-Analysis Pipeline
workflows.description:
Transcribes an uploaded audio/MIDI file to notes, branches rhythm analysis by
    detected content type, runs harmony analysis in parallel, merges everything into a
    structural analysis, and routes low-confidence transcriptions to a human
    musicologist before compiling the final report.
workflows.trigger: user uploads an audio file or MIDI file for analysis

workflows.name: Personalized Recommendation Pipeline
workflows.description:
Builds a listener preference profile and seed-track feature analysis in parallel,
    generates and curates candidate recommendations, loops regeneration until a
    relevance/diversity bar is met, and gates editorial-playlist placement behind a
    human curator's approval.
workflows.trigger: user or upstream system supplies listening history and/or seed tracks

nodes.label: Extract Harmonic/Style Features of Seed Tracks
Human Curator Approval for Editorial Playlist

workflows.name: Collaborative Co-Composition Workflow
workflows.description:
Generates a melodic/harmonic sketch and loops it through composer approval, then
    fans out into parallel lyric-writing and arrangement, joins the results, checks
    structural consistency, and loops revision until the piece is coherent.
workflows.trigger: user (composer) submits a creative brief: genre, mood, tempo, optional existing motif

workflows.name: Physics Problem Solving & Verification Pipeline
workflows.description:
Classifies an incoming physics problem by domain, routes it to the matching
    specialist solver, runs a dimensional/units and numerical sanity check on the
    result, and loops re-solving with error feedback until the answer passes sanity
    checks or a cap is hit.
workflows.trigger: user submits a physics problem statement with known quantities and a target unknown

workflows.name: Experimental Data Analysis & Simulation Validation Workflow
workflows.description:
Fits raw experimental data and runs a theoretical simulation in parallel, joins
    them for a goodness-of-fit comparison, loops model-parameter revision until the fit
    is acceptable, and gates the final conclusions behind PI/advisor sign-off before the
    lab report is generated.
workflows.trigger: user submits raw measurement data with uncertainties plus a theoretical model description
